info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Ecommerce Cart Coupons-v1-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Coupons Retrieval API enables users to access and retrieve a list of available coupons applicable to the ecommerce cart. This API supports businesses in optimizing customer purchases by providing relevant discount options directly associated with their ongoing shopping sessions. Typical consumers include frontend applications and ecommerce platforms that aim to enhance customer experience with promotions. By integrating this API, developers can ensure that users benefit from current offers, ultimately driving sales and customer satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve details about the available coupons for their cart. Use this to check coupon validity and potential discounts before applying them at checkout.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to apply a coupon to the shopping cart. It expects a JSON object that contains the necessary details to process the coupon application.

ListEcommerceCartCouponsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for obtaining coupon information in the cart operations.
